text:
Elaine (Partnerships): Quick alert — marketplace MDF capacity for the upcoming QBR is ~30% lower than our forecast. Need to reconcile committed co-marketing slots + partner scorecard KPIs by EOD Thu. @Samir can you pull partner-tier spend vs activation for marketplace listings?

Samir (Sales Ops): On it. pulling the last 4 qtrs now. expect a short summary in ~2hrs. any specific format? csv or quick slide?

Elaine (Partnerships): slide deck is fine. just 3 bullets per partner: committed MDF, spend to date, activation (lead gen / listings). highlight any >20% slippage.

Maria (Go-to-Market): tagging in scorecards — we should prioritize partners with >=Silver tier and >10 closed deals last qtr. If MDF limited, focus on those. Also want visibility into marketplace listing conversion rates.

Samir (Sales Ops): got the export. attaching minimal table here:
```
partner, tier, committed_mdf_usd, spent_usd, listings_activated, marketplace_leads
CloudCo, Gold, 12000, 8000, 2, 43
InfraSys, Silver, 8000, 7000, 1, 9
EdgeWorks, Bronze, 5000, 5000, 0, 1
```

Jake (Finance): FYI — any reallocation of MDF must hit the QBR workbook by COB Fri for approvals. If you plan to shift funds between partners, include a short ROI note.

Zoe (Comms): If we reduce co-marketing with any partner that has a joint announcement planned, need to lock messaging now. Which partners are on the announcement pipeline?

Elaine (Partnerships): Good call. announcement pipeline: CloudCo (ref arch launch), EdgeWorks (hardware marketplace bundle), and one deferred SI integration announcement (InfraSys). EdgeWorks is lowest activation so might be a candidate for pause. @Zoe can you draft a contingency comms blurb for a pause?

Zoe (Comms): Yep — will draft a neutral blurb: "marketing support to be rescheduled as we align on certification milestones". will post in #marketing for feedback.

dev-rel-bot: Automated note: marketplace listing conversion dashboard updated — https://redwood.example.com/marketplace/dashboards/conversion (last refresh 2026-03-10 09:12 UTC)

Samir (Sales Ops): Re-running numbers with ROI filter (>2x pipeline influence). Quick hits: CloudCo, InfraSys survive; EdgeWorks is questionable (low leads).

Elaine (Partnerships): Proposed action list: 1) Freeze EdgeWorks MDF re: marketplace until they show listing activation plan (due Mon). 2) Reallocate 6k from EdgeWorks -> CloudCo co-marketing (marketplace banner + webinar). 3) Jake to approve reallocation in QBR workbook. 4) Zoe to prep announcement contingencies for EdgeWorks/InfraSys. 5) Samir to publish updated scorecards.

Jake (Finance): I can approve conditional reallocation today if Samir adds expected incremental ARR / pipeline estimate for CloudCo. put numbers in the workbook, tag me.

Samir (Sales Ops): Will add: expected incremental pipeline = $90k (3-month outlook), confidence = medium. updating workbook now.

Maria (Go-to-Market): Also recommend a short performance playbook to hand to partners when MDF gets reallocated: "how to accelerate listing activation" — 3 tactical steps. I'll draft by Wed.

Elaine (Partnerships): Perfect. Folks — can we agree to the freeze + reallocate conditional on Jake's sign-off? thumbs? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

Samir (Sales Ops): :thumbsup:

Jake (Finance): :thumbsup: (pending workbook numbers)

Zoe (Comms): :thumbsup:

Maria (Go-to-Market): :thumbsup:

Elaine (Partnerships): Great — I will file this as the MDF reconciliation note for the QBR prep. If anyone finds issues, ping me. Closing thread once Jake confirms in workbook.

Samir (Sales Ops): uploaded workbook row: https://sheets.example.com/rdw-qbr-mdf#gid=0&range=A12 — tagged Jake.

Jake (Finance): Approved in workbook. moving funds and recording in commit ledger. thanks.

Elaine (Partnerships): Awesome — leaving this pinned to the QBR folder. final reminder: scoresheets for partners due by Tue COB next week.

Zoe (Comms): will sync with marketing on announcement timeline.

Maria (Go-to-Market): I'll prep the partner playbook draft. thanks all.
